versions.changelog:
wechat-mp-publisher-pro 1.0.0

- Initial release: End-to-end automation tool for WeChat Official Account content production and publishing.
- Features full workflow: data collection, topic planning, article writing, auto-formatting with images, account management, publishing, and post-publication analysis.
- Supports user intent recognition and routing for hotspot collection, writing, formatting, publishing, and analytic review.
- Provides structured workflows, confirmation checkpoints, style/design references, and output previews at each stage.
- Streamlines content creation for WeChat Official Accounts; not applicable to other platforms or technical documentation.
